name: @temporeum/timeline-docs
description: Docs site with live examples and recipes, framework templates, the comparison benchmark, and the Playwright device-emulation suites.

scripts.build: npm run --silent build -w @temporeum/timeline-core && npm run --silent build -w @temporeum/timeline-element && node scripts/build-site.mjs
scripts.bench:public: npm run --silent build && node ../../scripts/sdk_bench.mjs public && node ../../scripts/sdk_check_perf.mjs public
scripts.bench:deep: npm run --silent build && node ../../scripts/sdk_bench.mjs deep && node ../../scripts/sdk_check_perf_deep.mjs
scripts.bench:wheel: npm run --silent build && node ../../scripts/sdk_bench.mjs wheel && node ../../scripts/sdk_check_perf_wheel.mjs
scripts.bench:labels: npm run --silent build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.bench-labels.json',{force:true})" && node ../../scripts/sdk_bench_field.mjs labels && node ../../scripts/sdk_check_bench_labels.mjs
scripts.bench:pan-memory: npm run --silent build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.bench-pan-memory.json',{force:true})" && node ../../scripts/sdk_bench_field.mjs pan-memory && node ../../scripts/sdk_check_pan_memory.mjs
scripts.bench:gantt: npm run --silent build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.bench-gantt.json',{force:true})" && node ../../scripts/sdk_bench_gantt.mjs && node ../../scripts/sdk_check_perf_gantt.mjs
scripts.bench:resources: npm run --silent build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.bench-resources.json',{force:true})" && node ../../scripts/sdk_bench_resources.mjs && node ../../scripts/sdk_check_perf_resources.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:touch: npm run --silent build -w @temporeum/timeline-core && playwright test e2e/touch.spec.ts && node ../../scripts/sdk_check_e2e_touch.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:touch:webkit: npm run --silent build -w @temporeum/timeline-core && node -e "for (const f of ['.e2e-touch-webkit-report.json','.ios-touch-report.json']) require('node:fs').rmSync(f,{force:true})" && (playwright test -c playwright.webkit.config.ts; node ../../scripts/sdk_ios_touch.mjs; node ../../scripts/sdk_check_e2e_touch_webkit.mjs)
scripts.test:e2e:responsive: npm run --silent build -w @temporeum/timeline-core && playwright test -c playwright.responsive.config.ts && node ../../scripts/sdk_check_responsive.mjs
scripts.test:a11y: npm run --silent build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.axe-results.json',{force:true})" && playwright test -c playwright.a11y.config.ts && node ../../scripts/sdk_check_a11y.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:async: npm run --silent build -w @temporeum/timeline-core && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.async-browser-log.json',{force:true})" && playwright test -c playwright.async.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:cluster: npm run --silent build -w @temporeum/timeline-core && node -e "for (const f of ['.cluster-browser-log.json','.e2e-cluster-report.json']) require('node:fs').rmSync(f,{force:true})" && playwright test -c playwright.cluster.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:print: npm run --silent build -w @temporeum/timeline-core && npm run --silent build -w @temporeum/timeline-element && node -e "for (const f of ['.print-browser-log.json','.e2e-print-report.json']) require('node:fs').rmSync(f,{force:true})" && (TL_PAGES_SPEC=print.spec.ts TL_PAGES_REPORT=.e2e-print-report.json TL_PAGES_PORT=41769 playwright test -c playwright.pages.config.ts; node ../../scripts/sdk_check_print.mjs)
scripts.test:e2e:tooltip: npm run --silent build -w @temporeum/timeline-core && npm run --silent build -w @temporeum/timeline-element && node -e "for (const f of ['.tooltip-browser-log.json','.e2e-tooltip-report.json']) require('node:fs').rmSync(f,{force:true})" && (TL_PAGES_SPEC=tooltip.spec.ts TL_PAGES_REPORT=.e2e-tooltip-report.json TL_PAGES_PORT=41767 playwright test -c playwright.pages.config.ts; node ../../scripts/sdk_check_tooltip.mjs)
scripts.test:e2e:drop: npm run --silent build -w @temporeum/timeline-core && npm run --silent build -w @temporeum/timeline-element && node -e "for (const f of ['.drop-browser-log.json','.e2e-drop-report.json']) require('node:fs').rmSync(f,{force:true})" && (TL_PAGES_SPEC=drop.spec.ts TL_PAGES_REPORT=.e2e-drop-report.json playwright test -c playwright.pages.config.ts; node ../../scripts/sdk_check_drop.mjs)
scripts.test:e2e:template: npm run --silent build -w @temporeum/timeline-core && npm run --silent build -w @temporeum/timeline-element && TL_PAGES_SPEC=template.spec.ts TL_PAGES_REPORT=.e2e-template-report.json playwright test -c playwright.pages.config.ts
scripts.bench:field: npm run --silent build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('site/benchmark/field/results.json',{force:true})" && node ../../scripts/sdk_bench_rivals.mjs && npm run --silent build && node ../../scripts/sdk_check_bench_field.mjs
